notes: Manufacturing, shelf life, logistics and sourcing details come from general knowledge, not the evidence.

food_beverage_category.value: Nutritional snacking: protein bars, protein chips, shakes and better-for-you snacks and meals

brand_private_label_manufacturing.value: Owned consumer brands (Quest, Atkins, OWYN), largely produced through third-party co-manufacturers

shelf_life_storage_condition.value: Shelf-stable packaged bars, chips and ready-to-drink shakes

temperature_controlled_logistics.value: Ambient distribution; no chilled or frozen chain needed for core products

customer_channel_sales_mix.value: Mainly retail: grocery, club and mass merchandise, plus e-commerce, convenience and specialty channels

input_food_safety_exposure.value: Protein (milk, whey, plant proteins), nuts, sweeteners and cocoa input costs; allergen management
